stories.title: Eleições no MA: veja como foi a cobertura do 1º turno das Eleições 2026

en.title: Elections in MA: see how coverage of the 1st round of 2026 Elections was
en.summary: Over 5 million residents of Maranhão participated in the first round of 2026 elections. Voting occurred from 8am to 5pm Brasília time, with voters selecting federal deputies, state deputies, senators, governor, and president.

stories.title: Deputados federais eleitos na Bahia: veja a lista

en.title: Federal deputies elected in Bahia: see the list
en.summary: Bahia voters elected 39 federal deputies for the Chamber of Deputies starting in 2027. The PT won the most seats with seven representatives, followed by PSD and União Brasil with six each, and PL with four.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro supera desempenho do pai nos primeiros turnos de 2022 e 2018: veja comparativo

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro surpasses his father's performance in the first rounds of 2022 and 2018: see comparison
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro received more votes than his father Jair Bolsonaro in the first round of the 2026 presidential election. Flávio and Lula advanced to the second round of voting.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro conquista 714 cidades que tiveram maioria de Lula em 2022

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro wins 714 cities that had Lula majority in 2022
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula advanced to the second round of the 2026 presidential election with 47.03% and 45.16% of valid votes respectively, a difference of just 1.87 percentage points.

stories.title: Quem é Eduardo Braide, governador eleito no Maranhão no primeiro turno das eleições 2026

en.title: Who is Eduardo Braide, governor elected in Maranhão in the first round of the 2026 elections
en.summary: Eduardo Braide was elected governor of Maranhão in the first round of the 2026 elections.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 5 milhões de votos a mais do que o pai obteve no primeiro turno de 2022

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro has 5 million more votes than his father received in the first round of 2022
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro received 5 million more votes in the first round of 2026 compared to the votes his father obtained in the first round of 2022.

stories.title: Atritos e falhas marcam campanha de Lula, e líderes falam em mudanças profundas para enfrentar Flávio no 2º turno

en.title: Friction and failures mark Lula's campaign, and leaders speak of profound changes to face Flávio in the second round
en.summary: President Lula's campaign was marked by internal disagreements, political mistakes and strategic divergences, resulting in underperformance that left him behind Flávio Bolsonaro heading into the second round.

stories.title: Conhecido como ‘ruim de voto’, irmão de Bolsonaro é eleito deputado federal por SP

en.title: Known as 'bad at voting', Bolsonaro's brother is elected federal deputy for SP
en.summary: A brother of Bolsonaro, known for having electoral difficulties, was elected federal deputy for the state of São Paulo.

stories.title: Veja se sua cidade ou estado votou mais em Lula ou em Flávio Bolsonaro

en.title: Check if your city or state voted more for Lula or Flávio Bolsonaro
en.summary: The first round of the presidential election showed regional contrasts, with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva winning strongly in the Northeast while Senator Flávio Bolsonaro gained more voters in other regions.

stories.title: Lula vence na maioria das zonas eleitorais da cidade de SP; veja votação por região

en.title: Lula wins in most electoral zones in São Paulo city; see voting by region
en.summary: Lula won the majority of electoral zones in São Paulo city during the first round of voting.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro vai ao 2º turno com mais votos que Lula, empurrado por onda bolsonarista

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro advances to runoff with more votes than Lula, driven by Bolsonaro wave
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro secured a spot in the second round of the presidential election with a higher vote count than Lula, benefiting from strong Bolsonaro movement support.

stories.title: Flávio garante 5 palanques estaduais com aliados no 2º turno; Lula em 4

en.title: Flávio secures 5 state campaign platforms with allies in runoff; Lula in 4
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro secured political endorsements in five states whose gubernatorial candidates advanced to runoff elections, while Lula has support in four states. A record twenty states elected governors in the first round.

stories.title: Deputados federais eleitos pela Bahia (BA): veja a lista de 2026

en.title: Federal deputies elected by Bahia (BA): see the 2026 list
en.summary: Bahia elected 39 federal deputies to the Chamber of Deputies in the 2026 elections held on Sunday. The election uses a proportional system where votes are cast for parties or coalitions rather than individual candidates.

stories.title: Eleições 2026: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro vão ao segundo turno; siga

en.title: 2026 Elections: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro advance to runoff; follow
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro reached 47% of valid votes compared to President Lula's 45%, with both candidates heading to a second round scheduled for October 25. Lula expressed disappointment with the result but challenged Flávio to continue.

stories.title: Campanha de Flávio conta com Tarcísio como estratégia para o 2º turno

en.title: Flávio's campaign counts on Tarcísio as strategy for runoff
en.summary: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, who was reelected in the first round, is expected to play a key role in Flávio Bolsonaro's electoral strategy for the presidential runoff according to the senator's allies.

stories.title: Nikolas Ferreira é o deputado federal mais votado da história, com 3,1 milhões de votos

en.title: Nikolas Ferreira is the most voted federal deputy in history, with 3.1 million votes
en.summary: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira from Minas Gerais was reelected with a record 3.1 million votes, the highest vote count ever received by a federal deputy in Brazil. Ana Elisa from PT received the second-highest votes with 524,200.

stories.title: Deputados federais eleitos pelo Pará (PA): veja a lista de 2026

en.title: Federal deputies elected by Pará (PA): see the 2026 list
en.summary: Pará elected 17 federal deputies to the Chamber of Deputies in the 2026 elections held on Sunday. These representatives will take office on February 1, 2027, and serve four-year terms as part of the 513-member chamber.
